brand.name: Dawlance
brand.notes: Pakistani brand (Karachi, since 1980), part of Arçelik group. AC lines: inverter splits (Powercon, Enercon, Sprinter, Aura, Elegance, Chrome, Mega, Econo+, Excel, Magna, Avante, Extreme, Atmos, Frost, Chillex, Aeromax, Dual Pro, Suave+, Inspire), floor standing (Glamour+, Gallant+), plus fixed-speed splits. Service UAN: 021-111-11-7359. Dawlance makes no solar/UPS inverters — 'inverter' = inverter-compressor AC. No official public error-code page exists; official user-manual tables were OCR'd from image PDFs (see docs/sources/dawlance.md).

series.name: Splits — Inverter & Fixed-Speed (shared platform)
